summary.en:
- Himeko • Nova is a DPS unit with unique synergy with Trailblaze Companion units. She excels in AoE content, such as Pure Fiction. However, her performance is tied to having at least one Trailblaze Companion in the team.
- When Himeko • Nova is in the party, all allies gain access to her Assist Skill. When an ally uses her Assist Skill, their turn ends and Himeko • Nova launches an attack. If a Trailblaze Companion uses Assist Skill, they gain an extra turn. Additionally, Himeko • Nova can use her Assist Skill without reducing the usage counter.
- Himeko • Nova's Assist Skill has a maximum of one use. While she has Navigator's Semaphore from her Skill, the team gains one use of her Assist Skill at the start of her turn.
- Himeko • Nova will enter into one of two states depending on which Trailblaze Companion uses her Assist Skill: Verdict or Decimation.
- Trailblazer, Dan Heng, and Sunday will trigger Verdict. While in Verdict, after allies use two Ultimates, she will launch a bonus Assist Skill, up to a maximum of two.
- March 7th, Welt, and regular Himeko will trigger Decimation. While in Decimation, after allies attack nine enemies, she will launch a bonus Assist Skill, up to a maximum of two. The bonus Assist Skill conter resets for both states after Himeko • Nova uses Ultimate.

details.en:
- E2 increases the maximum uses of her Assist Skill to two and additionally generates a use of her Assist Skill at the start of her turn while Navigator's Semaphore is up. All allies also gain an additional turn after using her Assist Skill. Himeko • Nova's E2 is not only a large raw damage increase, but also allows for more flexible Assist Skill rotations.
- S1 [[light-cone:a-star-that-lights-the-night]] is a large personal damage increase and grants Himeko • Nova extra energy when an ally uses her Assist Skill.
- E1 increases the maximum Assist Skills triggered by Decimation and Verdict by one and increases their frequency. A solid personal damage increase.
